title: Android: Panic unwrapping None value while getting Native Activity. Native Activity is never not None.

labels.name: C-Dependencies
labels.description: A change to the crates that Bevy depends on

labels.name: P-High
labels.description: This is particularly urgent, and deserves immediate attention

labels.name: O-Android
labels.description: Specific to the Android mobile operating system

labels.name: S-Blocked
labels.description: This cannot move forward until something else changes

body:
## Bevy version

Bevy 0.8.0 dev, cloned today.

## Operating system & version
Windows 10, targeting android

## What you did

`cargo apk run --example android`

I get this when ran without any modifications
```
rust.example.android I/RustStdoutStderr: thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 'called 'Option::unwrap()' on a 'None' value', [...]\ndk-glue-0.6.1\src\lib.rs:60:39
```

which is 
```
    unsafe { NATIVE_ACTIVITY.as_ref().unwrap() }
```

When I modify the unsafe call to 
```
    //unsafe { NATIVE_ACTIVITY.as_ref().unwrap() }
    println!("Getting activity");
    unsafe {
      loop {
        let a = NATIVE_ACTIVITY.as_ref();
        match a {
          Some(_) => {
            println!("Found activity");
            ()
          },
          None => (),
        }
      }
    }
```

I get the print message that it's getting activity, but it never gets a non-none value. Might be related to https://github.com/rust-windowing/android-ndk-rs/issues/211
